propositions: Capability call sites cast to optional capability types but lack runtime isinstance guards before invoking optional members, creating silent failures when a transport lacks the capability.
An AttributeError from a missing optional capability is swallowed by broad exception handlers on the dispatch path, causing mutations to be silently skipped and reported as success.
The reconciler is inconsistent with itself: dispatch sites use cast without guards while fetcher.py sites gate identical capability checks with hasattr.

Four call sites reach for SupportsComments or SupportsLinks members without first verifying the transport implements them: create_one, _update_one_scalar_update, _update_one_dispatch_links, and _update_one_dispatch_comments.
Capability absence must be distinguished from capability-present-but-failed and recorded distinctly through the existing bridge_alerts channel as designed skips.
The dispatch_one module at 796 LOC requires relocation of _call_with_retry to dispatch_apply_phases to stay under the 800 LOC cap after adding guards.
